children: Solana Mobile said its third-party email marketing provider Brevo suffered a security incident that affected some customer accounts, including Solana Mobile. According to ChainCatcher, the company disabled its Brevo account after discovering unauthorized access and is working with Brevo to determine the scope of the information accessed.

Solana Mobile said it has not found evidence that any emails were sent from its account so far, but it is still verifying the situation. The company also reminded users that it will never ask for seed phrases, private keys, or wallet recovery information.

title: Solana Mobile Says Brevo Security Incident Affected Its Account
